name: Baleful Teleport
body:
Discipline Psychoportation (Teleportation); Level Nomad 5

MANIFESTING

Display Material and visual
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target One corporeal creature
Duration Instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Power Resistance Yes
Power Points 9

DESCRIPTION

You psychoportively disperse minuscule portions of the subject, dealing 9d6 points of damage. Targets can be protected from the effects of this power by wrench.

Augment For every additional power point you spend, this power’s damage increases by 1d6 points. For each extra 2d6 points of damage, this power’s save DC increases by 1 and your manifester level increases by 1 for the purpose of overcoming power resistance.
